### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>containers/gvisor-tap-vsock (github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock)</summary>

### [`v0.9.0`](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/releases/tag/v0.9.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/compare/v0.8.9...v0.9.0)

This release has several new features:

- an ICMP forwarder was implemented in [#​597](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/issues/597). Before this, `ping` was succeeding even for unknown addresses
- more DNS records (SOA/PTR/AAAA) are handled instead of being silently ignored ([#​696](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/issues/696))
- lock contention in packet forwarding is reduced to improve performance ([#​613](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/issues/613))
- source IP is correctly reported when running in a container ([#​634](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/issues/634))

There were also several security hardening features:

- Unix sockets are created with 0600 permissions ([#​683](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/issues/683))
- The REST API accessible in the virtual network can (optionally) require an authorization token before accepting requests ([#​724](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/issues/724))
- REST API use is logged for auditing purpose ([#​669](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/issues/669))
- gvproxy no longer attempts to remove files before listening on a unix socket ([#​718](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/issues/718))

This last change could cause regressions/trigger bugs in applications using `gvisor-tap-vsock`.
Please [file an issue](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/issues/new) if you have any problems with this change, or with this release in general.

#### What's Changed

##### New Features

- Add icmp forwarder by [@​evidolob](https://redirect.github.com/evidolob) in [#​597](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/597)
- fix(dns): forward SOA/PTR/AAAA and other unhandled query types by [@​ekalinin](https://redirect.github.com/ekalinin) in [#​696](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/696)
- tap: reduce lock contention in switch packet forwarding by [@​nirs](https://redirect.github.com/nirs) in [#​613](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/613)
- config: add option to configure IP addresses through command line by [@​redbeam](https://redirect.github.com/redbeam) in [#​614](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/614)
- Rework unix socket cleanup handling by [@​cfergeau](https://redirect.github.com/cfergeau) in [#​718](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/718)
- api: add Bearer token authentication to gateway API endpoints by [@​redbeam](https://redirect.github.com/redbeam) in [#​724](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/724)
- Log security-relevant gvproxy services API requests by [@​vyasgun](https://redirect.github.com/vyasgun) in [#​669](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/669)
- forwarder: propagate source IP by [@​AkihiroSuda](https://redirect.github.com/AkihiroSuda) in [#​634](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/634)
- Make TCP forwarder max in-flight connections and connect timeout configurable by [@​evidolob](https://redirect.github.com/evidolob) in [#​698](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/698)

##### Bug Fixes

- forwarder: improve error message for port conflicts by [@​redbeam](https://redirect.github.com/redbeam) in [#​655](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/655)
- Fix notification socket path handling on Windows by [@​Honny1](https://redirect.github.com/Honny1) in [#​693](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/693)
- security: cap the packet size in rxStream to prevent oversized packets by [@​vyasgun](https://redirect.github.com/vyasgun) in [#​670](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/670)
- sockets: set gvproxy-created unix sockets to 0600 by [@​vyasgun](https://redirect.github.com/vyasgun) in [#​683](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/683)
- fix(win-sshproxy): don't stop execution when setup log fails by [@​l0rd](https://redirect.github.com/l0rd) in [#​699](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/699)
- dns: add input validation to /add endpoint (RHDESK-553) by [@​redbeam](https://redirect.github.com/redbeam) in [#​684](https://redirect.github.com/containers/gvisor-tap-vsock/pull/684)
